  (function () {
    var noop = function noop() {};
    if ("performance" in window === false) {
      window.performance = {};
    }
    window.performance.mark = performance.mark || noop;
    window.performance.measure = performance.measure || noop;

            if (!params[Symbol.iterator]) {
                return;
            }

                'security_storage': 'granted',
                ...waitForUpdate ? { 'wait_for_update': waitForUpdate } : {}
            });

    var ssrInfo = {"cacheExclusionReason":"","renderBodyTime":615,"renderTimeStamp":1795602392854}
</script>

    <script type="wix/htmlEmbeds" id="pageHtmlEmbeds.bodyStart start"></script>

<script id="wix-first-paint">
    if (window.ResizeObserver &&
        (!window.PerformanceObserver || !PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes || PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.indexOf('paint') === -1)) {
        new ResizeObserver(function (entries, observer) {
            entries.some(function (entry) {
                var contentRect = entry.contentRect;
                if (contentRect.width > 0 && contentRect.height > 0) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(function (now) {
                        window.wixFirstPaint = now;
                        dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wixFirstPaint'));
                    });
                    observer.disconnect();
                    return true;
                }
            });
        }).observe(document.body);
    }
</script>


<script id="scroll-bar-width-calculation">
    const div = document.createElement('div')
    div.style.overflowY = 'scroll'
    div.style.width = '50px'
    div.style.height = '50px'
    div.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    document.body.appendChild(div)
    const scrollbarWidth= div.offsetWidth - div.clientWidth
    document.body.removeChild(div)
    if(scrollbarWidth > 0){
        document.body.style.setProperty('--scrollbar-width', `${scrollbarWidth}px`)
    }
</script>

style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">De acordo com pesquisas recentes no território verde-amarelo, a cada 10 veículos, cerca de 7 foram adquiridos a partir de financiamentos. É a maneira mais prática e comum de adquirir um veículo em nosso país. </span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;">&nbsp;</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Mas quais são os passos e os requisitos que preciso ter para que eu possa fazer um financiamento? O que é necessário para que as chances de aprovação sejam maiores?</span></span></span></span></span></span></p></div><div id="comp-ld1orerd" class="q9dEZ5 comp-ld1orerd" data-motion-enter="done"><div class="vV1v8L wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld1orerdinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld1orerdinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld1oresl" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld1oresl wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">1</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0ruvhz" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0ruvhz" data-motion-enter="done"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ruvhzinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ruvhzinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rk7o7-rotated-wrapper"><div id="comp-ld0rk7o7" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0rk7o7 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Nome Limpo</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0qzg6f" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0qzg6f" data-motion-enter="done"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0qzg6finlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0qzg6finlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0qpmu3" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0qpmu3 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Se a sua intenção é financiar um veículo, o primeiro passo é não estar negativado. Em outras palavras, garantir que seu nome não esteja na lista dos órgãos de proteção de crédito, como Serasa ou SPC.</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Ter alguma restrição no nome, pendência em aberto ou dívida em atraso leva o seu nome a ser negativado, prejudicando o seu nome e o seu “score”, indicando ao mercado que a pessoa é uma má pagadora. Por isso, é de extrema importância ficar com o nome limpo.</span></span></span></span></span></span></p></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld1ozl8z" class="q9dEZ5 comp-ld1ozl8z"><div class="vV1v8L wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld1ozl8zinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld1ozl8zinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld1ozlax" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld1ozlax wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">2</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0rwe90" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0rwe90" data-motion-enter="done"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rwe90inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rwe90inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rwe91-rotated-wrapper"><div id="comp-ld0rwe91" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0rwe91 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Score</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0rwe8x" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0rwe8x" data-motion-enter="done"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rwe8xinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0rwe8xinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0rwe8y1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0rwe8y1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Depois de ter deixado o nome limpo, outro passo importante para o financiamento é ter um bom score. Mas afinal, o que é isso?</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">O score é uma pontuação que indica ao mercado se você é um bom ou mau pagador, variando de 0 até 1000. Quanto mais próximo do mil, melhor é o perfil financeiro da pessoa, aumentando as chances de aprovação no financiamento.<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
Entretanto, quanto menor a pontuação, maiores são as chances de ter um pedido de crédito recusado.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></p></div></div></div></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0r9nbs-rotated-wrapper"><div id="comp-ld0r9nbs" class="comp-ld0r9nbs nJiBti wixui-horizontal-line"></div></div><div id="comp-ld0ryb1i" class="q9dEZ5 comp-ld0ryb1i"><div class="vV1v8L wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb1iinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb1iinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0ryb2y" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0ryb2y wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">3</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0ryb29" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0ryb29"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb29inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb29inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb2a1-rotated-wrapper"><div id="comp-ld0ryb2a1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0ryb2a1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Idade mínima e máxima</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0ryb2b3" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0ryb2b3"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb2b3inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0ryb2b3inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0ryb2d" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0ryb2d wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Outro fator que é levado em conta durante o processo de financiamento é a idade da pessoa. A idade mínima é de 20 anos, já que, antes disso, dificilmente a pessoa irá possuir um crédito robusto, não s</span></span></span></span></span><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">endo possível saber se é uma boa ou mau pagadora.</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Já a idade máxima é de 70 anos, isso, em razão da expectativa de vida no Brasil, cerca de 76 anos segundo o IBGE. Portanto, fazer a aprovação de um financiamento a longo prazo, seria um negócio arriscado.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></p></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0s370g" class="q9dEZ5 comp-ld0s370g"><div class="vV1v8L wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s370ginlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s370ginlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0s372m" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0s372m wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">4</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0s371p" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0s371p"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s371pinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s371pinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s371q1-rotated-wrapper"><div id="comp-ld0s371q1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0s371q1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Documentação</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0s371s2" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0s371s2"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s371s2inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s371s2inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0s371u1" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0s371u1 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Para que se possa fazer a aprovação do crédito, é necessário que a pessoa possua os seguintes documentos:<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
- RG ;<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
- CPF ;<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
- Comprovante de endereço ( Conta de água ou luz )<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
Uma dúvida frequente quanto ao financiamento é em respeito a exigência da Carteira de Habilitação. Não é de obrigatoriedade que a pessoa possua a CNH, há sim a possibilidade de ser feito o financiamento sem a presença dela. Entretanto, é necessário informar a instituição financeira sobre isso.&nbsp;</span></span></span></span></span></span></p></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld1plu3d" class="comp-ld1plu3d nJiBti wixui-horizontal-line"></div><div id="comp-ld0s4sjy" class="q9dEZ5 comp-ld0s4sjy"><div class="vV1v8L wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s4sjyinlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s4sjyinlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0s4slv2" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0s4slv2 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">5</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0s4sl12" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0s4sl12"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s4sl12inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s4sl12inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s4sl22-rotated-wrapper"><div id="comp-ld0s4sl22" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0s4sl22 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><h2 class="font_2 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:20px; line-height:normal; text-align:center;"><span style="font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:raleway-semibold,raleway,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Realizar seu sonho</span></span></span></span></h2></div></div></div></div></div><div id="comp-ld0s4sl34" class="evZSmJ comp-ld0s4sl34"><div class="y6PJGG wixui-box" data-testid="container-bg"></div><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s4sl34inlineContent" data-testid="inline-content" class=""><div data-mesh-id="comp-ld0s4sl34inlineContent-gridContainer" data-testid="mesh-container-content"><div id="comp-ld0s4sl5" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-ld0s4sl5 wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:17px; line-height:1.4em;"><span class="color_15 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:17px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:avenir-lt-w01_35-light1475496,avenir-lt-w05_35-light,sans-serif;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="letter-spacing:0em;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Passado todos esses passos, chegou a hora de realizar o seu sonho! <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Fique tranquilo, o financiamento é bem rápido e prático! Em menos de cinco minutos já temos a confirmação se o seu crédito foi aprovado!</span> Agora é com a gente e com os nossos bancos parceiros. Só iremos precisar que você nos informe sobre duas coisinhas. </span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<script id="wix-skip-played-animations">
    window.__pageRevealPromise && window.__pageRevealPromise.then(function() {
        requestAnimationFrame(function() {
            try {
                var stored = sessionStorage.getItem('wix-motion-played-animations');
                if (stored) {
                    var played = JSON.parse(stored);
                    for (var compId in played) {
                        if (played[compId]) {
                            var el = document.getElementById(compId);
                            if (el) {
                                el.dataset.motionEnter = 'done';
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        });
    });
</script>

			const header = document.getElementsByTagName('header')[0];

			let headerOffsetHeight = 0;

			if (header) {
				const headerPosition = window.getComputedStyle(header).getPropertyValue('position').toLowerCase();
				const isHeaderStickyOrFixed = headerPosition === 'sticky' || headerPosition === 'fixed';
				headerOffsetHeight = isHeaderStickyOrFixed ? header.offsetHeight : 0;
			}

			document.documentElement.style.scrollPaddingTop = `${wixAdsOffsetHeight + headerOffsetHeight}px`;
        </script>
